title: Remove allocator-layout and partial-element memory hazards from Candle tensor byte conversion

criteria: Typed and byte allocations retain their own allocator layouts; conversion helpers contain no unsafe pointer copies or reconstructed Vec ownership.
Malformed partial elements and shape/byte-count overflow fail before decoding, at aligned and unaligned addresses.
All numeric dtypes preserve little-endian values and serialized bit patterns; U16 conversion to U32 remains supported.
Workspace regression tests execute the actual public Tensor and alpha VarMap checkpoint save/load paths.
Full combined-tree integration, production audit, immutable qualification and private inference remain mandatory before promotion.

notes: No new dependency, audit exception or baseline reset. CPU flash attention concerns in unowned candle-nn registry source are reviewed separately; this task does not claim they are repaired.
